featuredRaces.title: The Merriest Night
featuredRaces.description: Join us at Timber Creek Park for a festive 5K Run, Mile Walk/Run, and Daisy's Reindeer Run. Register before December 1st for free race swag at packet pickup. Enjoy complimentary hot chocolate, food, crafts, music, and holiday entertainment after the race.
